surfaces.constructor: snapshots and validates the exact multi-input plan bytes
surfaces.addRuntimePort: maps one stable logical ID to exactly one declared external slot and expected source
surfaces.addDeferredPort: describes an optional or required semantic port with no graph input backing
surfaces.toJSON: describes exact plan bytes, sorted logical ports and a correlation-only manifest fingerprint
surfaces.inputPortStatus: read-only per-slot input contract and actual binding status
surfaces.consumerCompatibility: read-only semantic role, fingerprint-presence and minimum-revision predicates for one candidate consumer
surfaces.status: read-only complete logical coverage, exact plan binding, registry binding and graph preflight
surfaces.run: requires current bridge status then delegates to CompiledMultiInputGraph.run, which repeats graph preflight
surfaces.runWithTrace: requires current bridge status then delegates to CompiledMultiInputGraph.runWithTrace, which repeats graph preflight and observes the same execution
surfaces.verifyFlat: requires current bridge status and delegates numerical verification to CompiledMultiInputGraph.verifyFlat

runtime_status_values.runtime_backing_missing: a graph input has no logical port mapping
runtime_status_values.runtime_input_unbound: a mapped graph input has no tensor
runtime_status_values.bundle_plan_mismatch: bundle belongs to another exact input plan
runtime_status_values.source_mismatch: bound source differs from the manifest declaration
runtime_status_values.contract_mismatch: graph input plan predicates reject the bound tensor or metadata
runtime_status_values.runtime_backing_current: mapped source and graph input contract agree
runtime_status_values.deferred_no_runtime_backing: the logical port has no executable graph input

authority.manifest_fingerprint: FNV-1a for correlation only, not authentication

explicit_limits: Source is caller-declared; origin authentication and subject binding are outside this version.
Consumer compatibility checks semantic metadata only; actual operator compatibility is decided by graph execution.
The legacy semantic manifest v1 continues to describe the separate single-input workspace path.
